cfo_brief: Revenue increased $4.0B sequentially, from $26.04B in Q1 2024 to $30.04B in Q2 2024 (+15.36%), per 10-Q filings dated 2024-05-22 and 2024-08-22, respectively. This magnitude exceeds typical quarter-over-quarter variance for a mega-cap revenue base and would normally trigger scrutiny for one-time items, M&A timing, or accounting changes—however, unlike the subsequent Q2→Q3 jump (later tied to disclosed "unprecedented" Blackwell chip demand), no MD&A commentary, earnings-call language, or news corroboration exists in the current evidence set to substantiate a specific driver for this Q1→Q2 move. **Action item:** obtain the Q2 2024 earnings call transcript and MD&A section to confirm whether this increase reflects early Data Center/GPU momentum preceding the Blackwell ramp, or a distinct one-time factor requiring separate disclosure follow-up.
